intro: Ormak Grimshot is an experienced orc hunter trainer residing in the Hunter's Hall within Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Accompanied by his loyal wolf, Grimfang, he instructs young hunters of the Horde in tracking, marksmanship, and bonding with wild beasts.

p: Stationed within the Hunter's Hall in the Valley of Honor, Ormak Grimshot serves as a cornerstone of martial instruction for the Horde's trackers and marksmen. Alongside his companion wolf, Grimfang, Ormak imparts the foundational discipline needed to survive Kalimdor's harsh wilderness. For orc and troll hunters arriving from their trials in Durotar, he provides vital guidance on the sacred art of taming and commanding wild beasts, ensuring every hunter forms an enduring bond with their animal partner.
